claims.text: The same charge directs the committee to weigh workforce resiliency, educational pathways and private sector innovation.
claims.quote: Evaluate strategies to enhance workforce resiliency, align educational pathways with evolving employer needs, and promote private-sector-led innovation.
claims.source_title: Senate Committee on Economic Development

claims.text: The charge also asks the committee to find upskilling opportunities and responsible adoption of emerging technologies.
claims.quote: Identify opportunities for upskilling and the responsible adoption of emerging technologies to maximize employment opportunities.
claims.source_title: Senate Committee on Economic Development

claims.text: The charge closes by asking the committee to recommend how to keep the Texas labor market a national leader.
claims.quote: Make recommendations to ensure the Texas labor market remains a national leader in growth and opportunity.
claims.source_title: Senate Committee on Economic Development

claims.text: Dell reported record orders, record revenue and a record backlog in its AI server business specifically, not across the company.
claims.quote: our AI server business where we booked a record $60.9 billion in orders, recognized a record $16.4 billion in revenue and exited the quarter with a record $95 billion backlog
claims.source_title: Dell Technologies earnings press release, Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K

claims.text: Dell's record total company revenue for the quarter is a company-wide figure, stated separately from the AI server segment's own figures.
claims.quote: Record revenue of $47.0 billion, up 58% year over year
claims.source_title: Dell Technologies earnings press release, Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K
claims.note: The first draft said $47.0 billion is 'far larger than the AI server segment figure'. c23 carries THREE segment figures, $60.9 billion of orders, $16.4 billion of revenue and a record backlog, so that ranking is false for one of them and undefined against the others. The comparison is dropped rather than narrowed, because the frame refuses every arithmetic relation between them.

claims.text: The row the listing carries without a cancellation note is a public hearing of the same committee in the same room.
claims.quote: Economic Development Type: Public Hearing Location: E1.016 (Hearing Room)
claims.source_title: Upcoming Senate Committee Meetings, Texas Legislature Online
claims.note: This binds to September 22nd across TWO quotes, c3's dated row and this cell, which is the shape the run refused three times in the same file. It is allowed here and the three were not, for a reason the refusals name: the chair join asked a HEADING to bind a LIST ITEM in a different structural element, and this asks a TABLE ROW to bind its own cells, which is what a table is. The listing carries exactly two Economic Development rows and one of them carries the cancellation note in the same cell as its room.

rejected.finding: Angela Paxton chairs the committee and Kevin Sparks is vice chair
rejected.reason: Both names are on the committee page and two fetches agree, but the labels and the names sit in separate structural elements. CHAIR is a heading and the name is a linked list item beneath it, so no contiguous string on the page joins a label to a name. A quote would have to be assembled, which is the thing this file exists to prevent.

rejected.finding: a reason the September 3rd hearing was canceled
rejected.reason: No reason is published in either document looked in. The listing says only Canceled see notice, and the committee page lists no upcoming meetings at all. The notice it points to lives under a robots-disallowed path and was not fetched. The absence is real in these two pages and is not evidence of the absence of a stated reason anywhere.

rejected.finding: the interim charge is an 89th Legislature interim charge
rejected.reason: The committee page carries the charge text but the 89th designation did not appear in either fetch. Dropped rather than carried over from the scout's framing.

rejected.finding: Dell recognized a record $16.4 billion in revenue
rejected.reason: The figure is the AI server business, not the company. The full sentence opens That's clearest in our AI server business where. Company revenue for the quarter is stated separately as Record revenue of $47.0 billion. Presenting $16.4 billion as Dell's revenue would be wrong by roughly a factor of three, so the segment words are welded into c23's quote.

rejected.finding: Dell's figures are for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, ended July 31, 2026
rejected.reason: Both fetches report this and the filename says q2fy27, but no contiguous verbatim span of four or more words carrying it was returned. The fiscal period is therefore kept out of every claim text rather than asserted on a quote that does not carry it.

rejected.finding: the Fort Worth ISD statement ends across the district with a comma
rejected.reason: The page renders it as a sentence ending in a period. The trailing comma in the lead is not what the page shows, so c12 quotes a substring that avoids the terminal punctuation entirely.

rejected.finding: the interim charge ends at promote private-sector-led innovation
rejected.reason: Not an error, a truncation. The lead's text is an exact prefix. The charge continues with two more sentences about upskilling and about recommendations, which are now c6 and c7. Any deck line implying the charge stops there would understate it.

rejected.finding: Palantir's Timpani is used at St. David's in Central Texas
rejected.reason: The article does not join them. It joins Timpani to HCA Healthcare, then separately notes that HCA also operates St. David's. The connection is corporate ownership, not deployment. c17 and c18 keep the two apart deliberately and the deck must not close the gap.

rejected.finding: Monica Gonzalez is a nurse at a Central Texas hospital
rejected.reason: The article describes her as a member of the National Nurses Union and does not name an employer in the sentences returned.

rejected.finding: dates for the SBOE rejection and the comptroller's voucher approval
rejected.reason: The article gives neither. Last summer is the only temporal marker for the rejection and no date at all attaches to the voucher acceptance. No vote counts appear either. Both remain unverified and must not be dated on a slide.

rejected.finding: Northside ISD is in San Antonio
rejected.reason: True by common knowledge and supported by the outlet and byline, but it is not inside any string pulled from the page. Kept out of c8's text rather than asserted on a quote that does not carry it.

rejected.finding: a count of Northside ISD teachers or staff receiving the tool
rejected.reason: The article gives no count. The only quantity is about prior use rather than about this rollout, and more than half is not a figure this project publishes as a number.

rejected.finding: OpenAI's own announcement of the district expansion
rejected.reason: openai.com returns 403 to this client. Never fetched, so nothing from it is in the file. Every OpenAI-side fact here is reported secondhand and labeled secondary_reported.

rejected.finding: the Dell dateline as a claim
rejected.reason: The dateline string in the filing carries an em dash, which is the character the filing uses. It is dropped rather than quoted, because the Round Rock location is not load bearing for this deck and a quote carrying a dash invites a lint argument that changes nothing about the story.

rejected.finding: The September 3rd meeting was the hearing on the AI interim charge.
rejected.reason: REFUSED BY THE INTEGRITY JUDGE AS A HARD FAIL, and it was the deck's premise. The listing's row gives a committee name, an hour, a type and a room, and no subject. The committee's own page carries the interim charge and lists no meeting against it. The document that would join them is the hearing notice the row links, at capitol.texas.gov/tlodocs/, which robots.txt disallows and this record does not crawl. So the join is an inference and the deck asserted it as fact in its title, its caption and its opening frame. What IS supported is that the committee carrying the charge lost a public hearing and has another one listed, and that the listing gives no subject for either. The deck says that now.
